verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure for AI agents, and a built-in assistant is a plausible feature for this kind of platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows integrations and skills that let external agents drive Steel browsers (OpenAI and Claude Computer Use, Browser-Use, CrewAI, the CLI skill). These are developer building blocks for bringing your own agent. There is no documented AI assistant inside Steel that a user can hand tasks to.
